behaviorSpec.message: You recover the Rail Proof: physical evidence that the Lodge's utility infrastructure connects to a concealed railway system.

specification.failureHint: The pipework and drainage channels seem to converge on the same machinery.
specification.successHint: The flooded system is controlled from this spindle assembly, but a removable control component is missing.

behaviorSpec.successMessage: The basement machinery forms one connected water-control system. The wheel mounted at the control assembly is a removable component, while the drainage channels and flooded lower works answer to the same machinery.
behaviorSpec.criticalClueFallback: Deliberate inspection of the control machinery reveals that the mounted wheel can be detached.

specification.failureHint: Some maintenance marks and fittings do not match ordinary cellar work.
specification.successHint: The hardware includes standardized rail-service fittings and maintenance evidence from a system larger than this basement.

behaviorSpec.successMessage: Among the maintenance debris is something that does not belong to ordinary cellar work: old railway-related hardware and markings, handled often enough to suggest deliberate estate use rather than discarded scrap.
behaviorSpec.criticalClueFallback: A deliberate search of the maintenance evidence can still recover the physical railway proof.

behaviors.name: DiceBox B1 Water Control Wheel Recovery

behaviorSpec.message: You detach and recover the Water Control Wheel from the basement machinery.
